name: POST /api/payments/:charge_id/distribute - Append immutable distribution ledger entries
description: Appends immutable, hash-chained distribution ledger entries splitting a captured charge among parties. The caller tenant is taken from the JWT (never the body); the body charge_id is overwritten with the path param. Requires a 3-letter ISO-4217 currency and a non-empty splits[] where each split has a string party_persona_id and a positive-number share. The charge must exist, be owned by the caller tenant, and be in status "captured"; the batch share sum and the cumulative-of-all-prior-distributions must not exceed the charge amount. Edge cases: cross-tenant charge, missing charge, non-captured status, zero/negative shares, empty splits, wrong-length currency, over-subscription.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not Bearer form (requireAuth)

errorCases.message: charge_id required / currency must be ISO-4217 3-letter / splits must be a non-empty array / splits[i].party_persona_id required / splits[i].share must be a positive number

errorCases.when: no charge row for the path charge_id

errorCases.message: caller tenant does not own resource tenant
errorCases.when: charge belongs to a different tenant than the JWT tenant

errorCases.message: cumulative distribution would exceed charge amount
errorCases.when: prior distributions + this batch exceed the charge amount
default fallthrough (also, due to a fail()-matcher case mismatch, a non-captured status or batch-sum-exceeds-amount currently lands here instead of 409)
